name: Global Daily Summary (GSOD) weather station observations
access: the global weather station data are from the weather records of the Global Daily Summary (GSOD), which are available from the National Centers for Environmental Information (NCEI) (www.ncei.noaa.gov/data/global-summary-of-the-day/archive/)

scales.note: Global Daily Summary (GSOD) network with over 8000 weather stations spanning 2003 to 2019 (17 years)
